scope: Measured local shared-host synthetic HTTP/PostgreSQL workloads; no real model or commercial Host execution. CP3 capacity and multi-hour mixed durability are NOT accepted.
delivery_commit_note: Local checkout remains at historical baseline plus staged changes; official connector commit and CI references are recorded by checkpoint handoff. Benchmark source SHA-256 identifies each measured driver.
raw_artifact_note: Listed files were produced locally and SHA-256 verified. This manifest alone does not claim local raw files were uploaded to Actions. Workflow-generated artifacts have separate remote digests.

environment.load_client_location: separate spawned API process(es), real loopback TCP; shared host

data.scale: bounded synthetic small world; not 100k-event medium design

retry_policy.deadline_scope: No new retry starts after budget; in-flight attempt may finish later within HTTP timeout

mixed_read_distribution.history: one additional FACT timeline per task

load.hot_fraction_meaning: Fraction of read subjects mapped to one shared item; shared writer candidates remain agents/10 in every profile
load.cache_boundary: per-process query-result cache cold/warm; PostgreSQL and OS caches are not flushed
load.shared_conflict_policy: one predetermined TEST_FIXTURE control command before stale deliveries; not resource arbitration by database arrival order
